claim: The XMapEdit observer truncates negative coordinates, so frames of a map translated by a fraction of 1,024 do not match; it also cannot draw a mirror (504 on a one-sided wall), which only the game shows.
evidence: Gravesend's release translation and underpass mirror, 2026-11-25.
xmapedit/src_blood/observe/obs_main.c:643-645: pose x, y, z read with an (int) cast, which truncates toward zero.
use: Snap poses to 1/1024 before comparing frames; judge mirrors in play.

checked.how: xmapedit/src_blood/observe/obs_main.c:643-645 reads a pose's x, y, z as (int)js_num(...): a C cast truncates toward zero, so a negative fraction moves the other way from a positive one. The mirror (504 on a one-sided wall) limit and the release translation are the agent's notes owner-walk-2026-11-25b and sewers-outside-city (2026-11-25). bloodmap.visual.run_observation at visual.py:346.
